description: Legitimate interactive sign-in with MFA satisfied, matches endpoint browser session

Anomalous: token/cookie replay sign-in from external IP with no MFA prompt (session already authenticated), ~75 seconds after cookie exfil observed on endpoint. Same sessionId reused (T1550.004 Use Alternate Authentication Material - Web Session Cookie).
Suspicious: new service principal created shortly after anomalous sign-in (T1136.003 Create Cloud Account, persistence).

activityDisplayName: Add app role assignment to service principal
description: Suspicious: high-privilege Graph API permission (Mail.Read) granted to the new service principal (T1098.001 Additional Cloud Credentials).
Service principal sign-in used to call Graph API directly, bypassing user MFA entirely (T1078.004 Valid Accounts - Cloud Accounts).
Legitimate user's own later sign-in from real location, unrelated to the compromise
